slides.title: The *hard day rule.
slides.body: For when the plan falls apart.

slides.title: You will *miss a day.
slides.body: Travel, a bad night, a client fire. It's not a character flaw.

slides.title: *Never miss twice.
slides.body: One missed day is an accident. Two is the start of a new habit.

slides.title: Shrink it, don't *skip it.
slides.body: Ten minutes of the workout. One paragraph of the plan. Keep the streak alive.

slides.title: Decide the *minimum now.
slides.body: Write the smallest acceptable version of each habit today, before you need it.

slides.title: Consistency is about the *comeback.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
